# `aitbc ipfs island swarm-key`

Request the swarm key for a subscribed island IPFS network. Signs an authorization challenge with the wallet key and calls the coordinator swarm-key endpoint. The coordinator checks the on-chain subscription before returning the key.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ipfs island swarm-key [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name whose address is subscribed |
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | Island identifier |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator API base URL |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Blockchain chain ID (auto-detected from RPC if omitted) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL for chain ID auto-detection |
| `--api-key` | text | — | no | Coordinator API key (default from config / AITBC_API_KEY / MINER_API_KEYS) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--output` | path | — | no | Optional path to write the swarm.key |
| `--bootstrap` | flag | `false` | no | Also print a bootstrap multiaddr for the hub island daemon |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ipfs island swarm-key --wallet <wallet_name> --island-id <island_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc ipfs island swarm-key --wallet <wallet_name> --island-id <island_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
